description: Images, a pipeline and runtime configuration that let anyone build, test and start the system from a clean clone without manual steps.
An image tagged with the commit SHA so every running container can be traced back to the exact source and pipeline run.
Compose `depends_on` with `condition: service_healthy`, which starts the apps only after their dependencies report healthy.
One trace id shared by the API's server span, the producer span and the worker's consumer span, made possible by injecting context into message headers.
Readiness fails while a dependency is down and recovers without a restart; liveness only reports whether the process can serve.
